A source in the mode repository reads its files from a generic local repository, with no network access. Download each file on a machine that is connected, then upload it with any client that writes to the file API. Upload each file to the mirror repository named in the command (the setting vulnerabilities.sources.osv.repository, and vulnerabilities.sources.kev.repository for the catalog). Whoever may deploy to that repository decides the advisory data of this installation.
